Result: Assume that \( n \) is a natural number greater than or equal to \( n_0 \). From now on, we will show that the absolute value of \( x_n y_n - a b \) is less than \( \varepsilon \).

AppliedTactic:
calc
        |x n * y n - a * b| = |(x n * y n - x n * b) + (x n * b - a * b)| := by
          rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
        _ ≤ |(x n * y n - x n * b)| + |(x n * b - a * b)| := abs_add _ _
        _ = |(x n)| * |y n - b| + |x n - a| * |b| := by
          rw [← sub_mul,← mul_sub,abs_mul,abs_mul]
        _ ≤ M * |y n - b| + M * |x n - a| := by
          have m1leM : m1 ≤ M := by
            rw [le_max_iff]
            left
            rw [le_max_iff]
            left
            exact le_refl m1
          have k1 : |x n| * |y n - b| ≤ M * |y n - b| := by
            have : |x n| ≤ M := le_trans (hm1.right n) m1leM
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this (abs_nonneg (y n - b))
          have k2 : |x n - a| * |b| ≤ M * |x n - a| := by
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Mgeabsb (abs_nonneg (x n - a))
          exact add_le_add k1 k2
        _ < ε /2 + ε /2 := by
          have Mpos : 0 < M := by
            rw [lt_max_iff]; left;
            rw [lt_max_iff]; left; exact hm1.left
          have k1 :  M * |y n - b| < M * (ε/ (2 * M)) := by
            apply (mul_lt_mul_left Mpos).2
            have n0gen2 : n₀ ≥ n2 := by
              rw [ge_iff_le,le_max_iff]
              right
              exact le_refl n2
            exact cn2 n (ge_trans ngen₀ n0gen2)
          have k2 : M * |x n - a| < M * (ε/ (2 * M)) := by
            apply (mul_lt_mul_left Mpos).2
            have n0gen1 : n₀ ≥ n1 := by
              rw [ge_iff_le,le_max_iff]
              left; exact le_refl n1
            exact cn1 n (ge_trans ngen₀ n0gen1)
          have : M * (ε / (2 * M)) = ε / 2 := by
            have : M ≠ 0 := by
              exact Ne.symm (ne_of_lt Mpos)
            rw [mul_div,div_eq_inv_mul,mul_inv,← mul_assoc,mul_comm,mul_assoc,inv_mul_cancel this,mul_one,div_eq_inv_mul,mul_comm]
          rw [this] at k1 k2
          exact add_lt_add k1 k2
        _ = ε := by
          exact add_halves  ε

And.right : This theorem allows for the extraction of the second component from a conjunction when given a proof of that conjunction.

ge_trans : This theorem establishes that in a preorder, if one element is greater than or equal to a second element, and the second element is greater than or equal to a third, then the first element is also greater than or equal to the third.
le_max_iff : An element is less than or equal to the maximum of two others if and only if it is less than or equal to at least one of those two elements.
mul_lt_mul_left : This theorem proves that for a positive element, multiplying two other elements by it results in an inequality if and only if the original elements are ordered in the same way.
le_refl : This theorem confirms that in a preorder, any element is related to itself under the less than or equal relation.
